issue_request: FHIR-51025 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested TestScript fixture sub-fixtures by adding TestScript.fixture.expression as Expression, dropping the proposed path element, and making TestScript.fixture.resource 1..1.
initial_application: Commit ba91e922ce318538784226167ba47b70cf786729, merged via HL7/fhir#3508 with FHIR-51024 and FHIR-51111, added TestScript.fixture.expression to source/testscript and examples. That application left fixture.resource at 0..1 and did not update the active FHIR model-definition Library's TestScript.Fixture metadata.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2025-06-23 record the 13-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote. Later commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed TestScript/TestReport/TestPlan from active core resources and added the FHIR Testing IG reference. Current core therefore should not re-add source/testscript; the authoritative TestScript StructureDefinition now lives in HL7/fhir-testing-ig, where fixture.expression exists as Expression but fixture.resource still has min 0. The core Library resource remains active and publish.ini copies library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml, so that model metadata is still a current core build surface.
reconciliation: Published a non-empty core commit adding expression as FHIR.Expression to TestScript.Fixture in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml and regenerated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its data attachment matches the content XML. The commit intentionally does not change TestScript.fixture.resource cardinality in core because that StructureDefinition is no longer in this checkout and model-definition metadata does not encode element minimum cardinalities.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: regenerated the Library.data attachment to match the updated model-definition content.
